objective: Avoid materializing an identity-encoded copy for compatible R2007+ DXF semantic strings while preserving strict text validation/quoting and legacy codepage conversion.

behavior: Adds an internal read-only DXF-mode query to the text codec.
For compatible DXF output at AC1021 or later, writeUtf8String passes the original UTF-8 bytes directly to the synchronous string sink.
RequireLossless continues through strict UTF-8 validation and CIF-sensitive backslash quoting.
Pre-AC1021 compatible output continues to use its selected legacy codepage converter.
implementation.compatibility: No installed header, public class layout, DRW_Interface callback, or default output byte behavior changed; the bypass is gated to the identity-mapped modern DXF route.

controls: ASCII and Binary AC1021/AC1032 compatible output with multibyte UTF-8 and CIF-looking literal text.
Strict AC1021 output retains quoted CIF-sensitive wire spelling.
AC1018 compatible output retains CP1252 byte conversion.
limits: No allocation counter, throughput benchmark, or peak-RSS measurement was run; copy avoidance is established by the gated source path and output equivalence controls.
This does not establish complete Unicode mapping semantics, full text correctness, or broad DXF/DWG support.
No full suite, peer runtime, native CAD application, or fuzz/sanitizer campaign was run.
next_unblocked_slice: Inspect remaining DXF writer/projection paths for one separately demonstrated owned copy with a narrow byte-equivalence control; otherwise continue with the next specialized raw/typed carrier.
